import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem fibonacci_recurrence_unique (a : ℕ → ℕ) (h₀ : a 1 = 1) (h₁ : a 2 = 1) (h₂ : ∀ n, a (n + 2) = a (n + 1) + a n) :
  ∀ b : ℕ → ℕ, b 1 = 1 → b 2 = 1 → (∀ n, b (n + 2) = b (n + 1) + b n) → ∀ n, b n = a n := by
  intro b hb1 hb2 hb_rec n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n IH =>
    match n with
    | 0 =>
      have ha0 : a 0 = 0 := by
        have h := h₂ 0
        have h_eq : 1 = 1 + a 0 := by simpa [h₀, h₁] using h
        have h_eq' : 1 + 0 = 1 + a 0 := by simpa using h_eq
        exact (Nat.add_left_cancel h_eq').symm
      have hb0 : b 0 = 0 := by
        have h := hb_rec 0
        have h_eq : 1 = 1 + b 0 := by simpa [hb1, hb2] using h
        have h_eq' : 1 + 0 = 1 + b 0 := by simpa using h_eq
        exact (Nat.add_left_cancel h_eq').symm
      simp [ha0, hb0]
    | 1 =>
      simp [h₀, hb1]
    | k+2 =>
      have ha_rec := h₂ k
      have hb_rec' := hb_rec k
      have hk_lt : k < k + 2 := Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right (by norm_num : 0 < 2)
      have hk1_lt : k + 1 < k + 2 := Nat.lt_succ_self (k+1)
      have h_eq_k := IH k hk_lt
      have h_eq_k1 := IH (k+1) hk1_lt
      calc
        b (k+2) = b (k+1) + b k := hb_rec'
        _ = a (k+1) + a k := by simp [h_eq_k1, h_eq_k]
        _ = a (k+2) := by symm; exact ha_rec

  ∀ b : ℕ → ℕ, b 1 = 1 → b 2 = 1 → (∀ n, b (n + 2) = b (n + 1) + b n) → ∀ n, b n = a n := by

    | 1 => simp [h₀, hb1]
    | 2 => simp [h₁, hb2]

        exact h

        _ = a (n + 2) + a (n + 1) := by rw [ih1, ih2]
